question: Can the same market-wide lower-band reversal research produce 36 or 72 nonoverlapping entries per year with acceptable net performance?
signal: UTC aligned weekly first lower-touch ledger, all original alarm cooldown bars retained, fully observable initial and wait. Original universe definition and USTC exclusion from returns preserved.
selection: Use pre-2023, 2023-24 and 2025 only. Use 2026 through Oct 27 for historical chronological replication. No candidate selection on 2026. Show all failed frequency or profitability gates and no pooled cross-asset opportunity counts.
fixed: Reuse the old VectorBT 6/12/24/48/72/144 hour native fills and max(24h,hold) admission. Require breadth count >=2 and annual frequency. Two tiers per asset. Frozen candidates selected on 2025 or earlier.
six_day_ETH: Keep 10-minute initial window, 120-minute observation and original ETH exit policy 67. Test relaxing original breadth, continuation and BTC confirmation over a bounded family. Enter only flat, at least 24h since last entry and at least one 5min candle after its actual exit. Keep original six-day reservation as paired reference. No compounding across overlapping signals.
six_day_selection: For each frequency tier require at least 50 pre-2023, 2x tier in 2023-24, tier in 2025 and >=8 populated 2025 months. Prefer positive means all 3 periods, 2025 close-to-close trade-settlement drawdown <=35%; sort by worst period clipped lower confidence score then 2025 mean and fixed lexical names. If no profitable choice meets the floor label best frequency-eligible diagnostic explicitly.
fee: Both market fills 0.05% per side. Slippage sensitivity minus 0.20 percentage points per round trip. Realized USDM funding reported separately on frozen 2026 test entries.
controls: Same asset/month/time-of-day/volatility/trend and observation calendar, prior-known shock exclusion, matched long using same exit. Event-weighted month block sign tests, Holm correction; no funding in either side of random comparison.
tiers_are_assumptions: 36 and 72 annual opportunities correspond to 3 and 6 per calendar month on average. No minimum in any single month was requested.
